byte_audit_conclusion: Only mapped tip POSITION rows and their six min/max components changed. Roots, body, normals, UVs, joint/weight data, skin, animations, materials and textures are exact. Existing root-motion equivalence follows byte identity; no new pose audit performed.

cheek_normal_control.attribution: Normals contribute to the shading defect, but source-normal restoration alone does not produce a smooth-looking cheek. Remaining geometry/custom-normal interaction is not separated into a unique cause by this pair.
cheek_normal_control.bound_native_evidence: 594 selected corners on198faces exactly match source-v7 normals; nonselected normals exact; geometry/UV unchanged. Root report says baseline pixels exactly match prior gray control; this review did not repeat that unchanged check.
cheek_normal_control.limited_to: Plain gray material control; not a final textured model or geometry repair
cheek_normal_control.observation: Source normals reduce black/pitted contrast in the viewer-left cheek cluster; the raised angular/scalloped patch remains plainly visible.

comparison_limit: The renderer refits its camera to changed bounds, so prior/candidate images are not a pixel-registered A/B. No pixel-difference quality threshold is invented.

regional_fur.observation: Shorter, regionally directed tips remove most of the comb-like stubble around ears, cheek rim, belly, limbs and tail. The silhouette is cleaner and rounder than the previous tips.

rest_views.front: Recognizable panda/dragon, cleaner belly and ear edges; the companion occludes much of the damaged contact area.
rest_views.side: Smooth short-pile contour; no newly visible detached fur. This view does not expose the damaged cheek contact.
rest_views.three-quarter: Cleaner round head/ear and tail contour. Existing long protruding tail shape is unchanged.
